data.title: 不知火舞 · 道场红绸的花嫁扇舞
data.description: 【不知火流道场·黄昏】不知火舞穿着红白花嫁礼装站在道场中央，折扇与捧花分别握在两手；她先以熟练步法旋身让红绸扬起，再收扇面对镜头，笑容既有大和抚子的端庄也有胜负场上的自信。
data.action: 道场中央以扇舞扬起红绸，收扇面对镜头，端庄与武者自信并存
data.lighting: red-gold evening light across wooden boards
data.mood: 大和抚子与武者的花嫁扇舞
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui turns through the dojo in her red-and-white bridal kimono, folding fan in one hand and bouquet in the other. The long red sash follows a controlled arc before she closes the fan and faces the viewer with poised confidence beneath her white veil and floral pins. The vertical medium-full view retains the practice-floor perspective. Red-gold evening light highlights silk and high ponytail, with the sash's curling shadow across wooden boards.
